review.notes:
StudyPlanner Plus is available through the in-app subscription screen. To test Syllabus Scan, open the app, complete onboarding, choose Study Planner Plus, subscribe using Apple's sandbox purchase flow, then open Syllabus Scan from the Scan tab. Restore Purchases is available on the paywall.

Supported syllabus upload flow for this build:
1. Use the Scan tab after Plus is active.
2. Choose File for a text-based PDF or plain-text syllabus, Camera/Photo when the native iOS Vision OCR module is present, or Paste Text for copied syllabus text.
3. Review detected courses, deadlines, exams, notes, and grade categories.
4. Apply the parsed plan only after review.

Camera/photo OCR controls are enabled only when native iOS Vision OCR is available in the active scanner. If native OCR is unavailable, the app directs students to text-based PDFs or pasted text instead of applying uncertain data. Text-based PDFs, plain-text files, and pasted text can parse locally; explicit parser upload paths remain gated by the configured HTTPS endpoint and EXPO_PUBLIC_SYLLABUS_IMAGE_PARSING_ENABLED=1.

The app uses Apple's standard EULA:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Privacy Policy:
https://political-turtle-752.notion.site/Study-Planner-Syllabus-AI-Privacy-Policy-51dfaa74348846e0996b2e0ca22b1408
